question: to the Commission Martin Sonneborn (NI) Subject:

From 20 April to 21 June 2026, to mark Europe Day and the 81st anniversary of the Schuman Declaration, the Commission ran the campaign ‘Protect what matters: our democracy’ (Havas Paris, Havas Play, Havas Media, Prose on Pixels), securing over 75 440 outdoor advertising spaces in 3 650 cities across all 27 Member States, aimed at young Europeans. This question builds on the question submitted separately as E-002586/2026 on the costs and contractual framework of the same campaign. 1.
What measurable objectives and indicators were established for the campaign?
What baseline data from which specific sources formed the basis for the conception of the campaign?
Will there be an independent evaluation of the campaign – if so, by whom, according to which methodology, and when will the results be published?
